title: Dual-Branch Gated Fusion for Open-Set Audio Deepfake Source Tracing
abstract: arXiv:2606.10223v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Attributing a synthetic utterance to its originating system remains an open challenge: closed-set models fail to reject unseen synthesizers and produce overconfident predictions. To address this, we propose a dual-branch gated fusion framework that pairs XLSR-53 with CORES, a 66-dimensional descriptor that, unlike prior Linear Filter Bank (LFB)-only work, spans cepstral, oscillatory, rhythmic, energy, and spectral dimensions to capture complementary synthesis artifacts. Our analysis shows XLSR-53 remains discriminative in-domain (ID) while CORES generalizes stably under distribution shift (OOD), yet their naive concatenation fails due to SSL representational imbalance. To resolve this, an input-conditioned gate adaptively weights each branch under joint training with cross-entropy, an energy margin loss for ID/OOD separation, and a gate diversity term. On the MLAAD benchmark, our system achieves 97.6\% ID accuracy, 4.9\% EERc,

translated_title: 面向开放集音频深度伪造来源溯源的双分支门控融合方法
translated_abstract: 将合成语音归因于其来源系统仍是一个悬而未决的挑战：闭集模型无法拒绝未见过的合成器，并且会产生过度自信的预测。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种双分支门控融合框架，将XLSR-53与CORES相结合。CORES是一个66维描述符，与以往仅使用线性滤波器组（LFB）的工作不同，它涵盖倒谱、振荡、节奏、能量和频谱等多个维度，以捕获互补的合成伪迹。我们的分析表明，XLSR-53在域内（ID）保持判别能力，而CORES在分布偏移（OOD）下能稳定泛化，但由于SSL表征失衡，两者的简单拼接会失效。为解决该问题，输入条件门控在联合训练下自适应地为每个分支分配权重，联合训练包含交叉熵、用于ID/OOD分离的能量边际损失以及门控多样性项。在MLAAD基准上，我们的系统达到了97.6%的域内准确率、4.9%的EERc（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一种双分支门控融合框架，将XLSR-53与多维描述符CORES结合，通过输入自适应门控及交叉熵、能量边际损失和门控多样性项的联合训练，实现开放集音频深度伪造来源溯源，在MLAAD基准上取得97.6%的域内准确率。
en_tdlr: A dual-branch gated fusion framework pairing XLSR-53 with the 66-dimensional CORES descriptor, trained with cross-entropy, energy margin loss, and gate diversity terms, enables robust open-set audio deepfake source tracing and achieves 97.6% in-domain accuracy on MLAAD.
